plugins.name: polaris
plugins.description: Strategy-as-code for Claude Code. 4-layer model (Mission, Philosophy, Goals, Specs) plus a lightweight Issues log: every Spec links to a parent Goal, every Goal connects to Mission, Philosophy principles stay invariant across Goal changes, Clarity Gate interrogation on each strategic layer.
